title: usenet-ipfs-transit: wire daemon startup and event loops
description: The transit daemon has complete pipeline, gossipsub, peering, and GC logic but main.rs never starts any async work. This epic wires the rust-ipfs client, gossipsub swarm, peering TCP accept loop, and group-log reconciliation into a running daemon. Outcome: the transit binary starts, connects to IPFS, joins the gossipsub mesh, accepts peering connections, and processes IHAVE/TAKETHIS traffic. Why: without this, no articles propagate between peers and the transit daemon cannot be deployed.
